title: Least squares three ways
brief: Fit the same line with the normal equations, QR, and the SVD, then see the first one lose accuracy.
hints: condition_number: s = np.linalg.svd(X, compute_uv=False) is sorted largest first, so return s[0] / s[-1].
residual_orthogonality: compute r = y - X @ w, then np.abs(X.T @ r).max(), and wrap it in float().
fit_qr: Q, R = np.linalg.qr(X, mode='reduced'), then solve_triangular(R, Q.T @ y, lower=False).
fit_normal_equations: L = np.linalg.cholesky(X.T @ X). Solve L z = X.T @ y with lower=True, then L.T w = z with lower=False.
fit_svd: keep = s > rcond * s[0]. Use U[:, keep], s[keep], and vt[keep], so the tiny singular values are dropped instead of divided by.
